page.overview:
What is Unidentified raiders?

A group of raiders operated on the ice world of Barton IV. They stole crates of Imperial armor and weapons from an outpost guarded by Mayday's squad. To protect themselves from the cold, the raiders wore bandages and even the armor of clones they had killed.
